CustomField.description: BOPI-701 Twinned from Product, indicates if it has tiered pricing; sent to NS and triggers creation of NS Pricebook when True. External Description will display the standard tiered pricing when this field = True.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Product has tiered pricing that will display in External Description and triggers NS pricebook creation when True.
CustomField.label: Tiered Pricing
